cohort: The study included 452 singleton late preterm pregnancies (34+0 to 36+6 weeks gestation) delivered between 2014 and 2021.
finding: Antenatal corticosteroid therapy (ACT) was associated with a 42% reduction in the odds of neonatal pulmonary complications in late preterm pregnancies, with the most significant protective effect in earlier gestational weeks.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with a nearly fourfold increase in pulmonary complications compared to vaginal delivery, and ACT showed the most significant protective effect among cesarean deliveries.
